name: Icone Desktop
description:
Desktop icons for GNOME on Wayland, in the style of DING.

* Shows the contents of the Desktop folder, plus optional Home, Trash and mounted drives
* Multiple selection (Ctrl/Shift click, rubber band) and free or grid-aligned positioning
* Drag and drop between icons, folders, Trash and other applications such as Nautilus
* Context menus on the background and on icons, plus a panel indicator
* Preferences for icon size, labels, placement of new icons, sorting and behaviour

The desktop is drawn by a small GJS/GTK4 helper process launched by the extension.
Clipboard: the extension reads and writes the clipboard only when you copy, cut or paste files on the desktop (Nautilus-compatible format). Nothing is sent anywhere.
